creator: Alexander Terp
description: Resuming after a restart (a_27QdHGMeC) runs claude --resume <id>, which drops the flags the agent was started with: model, effort, --permission-mode, --settings. So a worker started with ct -m 2 comes back asking for permission it had skipped. That fails safe, but a person has to re-grant or restart it. Carrying the original launch forward means knowing it: the pane's --run command, or the hooks reporting it.
title: ▶️ A resumed agent keeps the flags it was started with
